inspiration: A spell is one flat record (cast time, mana cost, min and max damage, level, effect link); keep the flat shape for data-driven skills, add a telegraph window. Ref Faolan.Core/Data/Spell.cs lines 10-15.
Each NPC carries one integer faction next to health, stamina, mana and exp reward; a faction id can drive a shared hate list for many-on-one fights. Ref Faolan.Core/Data/Npc.cs lines 14-18.
The class kit is one byte-typed enum with twelve entries; a small archetype enum keeps kits as data. Names are game-specific; keep the shape only. Ref Faolan.Core/Enums/Class.cs line 3.
A hex packet dump is a replay-fixture idea: recorded wire bytes as test input for a fight record and replay (parity row 19). Ref Faolan/Resources/bigboy.txt (first bytes only).
Separate dev and production DB paths in one JSON config keep local and live data apart. Ref Faolan/faolan.json.

briefs.why: one row per skill makes a kit easy to tune

briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: spells reference fight-engine ids and carry a telegraph window instead of a plain cast time
